scope: Cold-feed stoichiometry and explicitly conditional phase/IR requirements.
cold_state_scope: Selected physical candidates are a50K sealed heterogeneous solid composite or separately conditioned hydrazine/N2 populations. The computational FEOSrho1000,T250 reference is a homogenized contact surrogate, not a claim of condensedN2at250K. Actual mixture density, void fraction, molecularEOS, interface mixing and capsule stresses remain requirements.

density_example.scope: Illustrative density choices, not measured15N composite data. Cryocrystal experiments show comparable molar-volume scales under specified containment pressure.

IR_reference.scope: Reuse radiation-interface smoothAl absorptivity reference.30kJ/kg is a chosen small-temperature-change budget, not a measured loss-of-function point. Capsule pressure/headspace may permit greater warming, with geometry/scattering consequences.

chemical_energy_scale.scope: Thermochemical scale for one product convention. Small energy fraction does not establish stability or prevent fragmentation during flight.
